name: Yuuki Serina
source:
Shinjo's beloved daughter, who lives with his ex-wife, Mao, following their divorce. She misses not being able to see her father, Shinjo. After seeing him for the first time in a long while in the news announcing AKIBA LOST, she calls him to say that, with her birthday just around the corner, she wants to celebrate it by sharing a birthday cake together.

[From in-game profile]
